about_the_game:
A strategy-driven FPS where you solve puzzles, explore vast and confined areas, and exterminate malicious creatures alongside your robot companion.

Explore and wreak havoc on diverse, old-school-style maps—each presenting its own unique challenge.

Manage your resources carefully; you can never have enough ammo. Master a blood-based energy system: dominating enemies grants you power to swing a giant sword, repair your robot friend, and wield powerful weapons.

Master your companion’s abilities too—you can directly control some, and use positive reinforcement to condition others. Your sentry’s fighting style evolves based on your choices!

Save your progress anytime with an old-school style save system.

content_descriptors.notes: Display of weapons, unrealistic blood, a very low-poly pile of corpses.
